root_cause_diagnosis: 1. CHK-BIDI-ALIGNMENT-INVERSION: The script compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py explicitly injects <w:jc w:val='right'/> for Persian headings in post_process_openxml and add_h functions, violating the OpenXML BiDi Golden Rule which requires omitting w:jc for right alignment under RTL to prevent trailing-edge flip. 2. CHK-NARRATIVE-JUSTIFICATION: Paragraphs copied from Chapter_4_Preamble_Source.docx retained their original left/right alignment, and post_process_openxml failed to enforce <w:jc w:val='both'/> on narrative paragraphs. 3. CHK-TABLE-BIDI-DIRECTION: post_process_openxml used tblPr[0].append(...) to add <w:bidiVisual/>, placing it at the end of the element list (after <w:tblW>) and violating strict CT_TblPr sequencing. 4. CHK-ENGLISH-WORD-LEAKAGE: Acronyms (IUS, SCI, etc.) in the copied Table 1 from the preamble source were not sanitized or translated to Persian during the copy process. 5. CHK-CHAPTER5-PROSE-ONLY: The validation script brittlely triggered Chapter 5 detection upon finding the section 8-4 heading 'پل انتقال مفهومی به فصل پنجم (بحث و نتیجه‌گیری)', thereby misapplying Chapter 5 rules to Chapter 4.
prescribed_behavior: 1. Modify compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py to omit <w:jc w:val='right'/> for headings; use only <w:bidi w:val='1'/>. If <w:jc> exists, remove it. 2. Enforce <w:jc w:val='both'/> for all substantive narrative paragraphs in post_process_openxml. 3. Fix table BiDi injection in post_process_openxml to use insert(0, ...) instead of append(...) so <w:bidiVisual/> precedes <w:tblW> or follows correct CT_TblPr sequencing. 4. Implement an acronym translation map to sanitize English text in preamble tables during copy. 5. Update academic_chapter_auditor.py to strictly distinguish between 'فصل پنجم' as a chapter title versus a bridge heading in Chapter 4.
